title: StratumTracker clear does not invalidate pre-clear network time samples
description: Fresh final timing correctness review: StratumTracker._clear_locked advances direct-provider issuance barriers but does not invalidate or barrier unconsidered DioTimeVerifier network samples. A valid network sample issued before clear can be adopted afterward and silently re-establish wall clock, defeating source invalidation. Clear must advance a per-authority issuance barrier or revoke all outstanding network samples while preserving replay/key-generation high-water state. Test pre-clear issued sample after clear, pre-clear rejected sample, fresh post-clear DIO, repeated clear, and unrelated authorities.
